# Materialism

Borrowing from Wikipedia, Materiialism is the philosophical doctrine that matter has the primary position in nature. More colloquially, when one talks about \`\`Materialism", one often uses that in the context of an individual's tendency of attachment to Materialistic reality. This is the connotation I would use in this blogpost.
